desc: The EAA Akkar Churchill 220 is the perfect home defense semi automatic shotgun, imported by European American Armory and made by Akkar. You will notice that this shotgun is designed for the individual who takes home defense seriously recognizing the loss of fine motor skills during stressful situations is a real factor. Unlike a pump action shotgun which requires manipulation between shots this semi automatic will just keep going with the simple act of squeezing the trigger. This particular model comes with an 18.5" defensive barrel and a 26" field barrel. The stock and forend are made from a super durable polymer and everything features a standard black finish.
